what_works: Paris metalworking atelier presents bespoke pieces in a magazine-spread layout — generous gutters, asymmetric two-up image pairings, captions set as small italics. Reads as a portfolio monograph, not a service brochure.
what_does_not_translate: French-language editorial voice doesn't carry; the layout discipline does. Mirror the spread composition with English contractor copy.
type_observations: Editorial serif headlines, italic caption layer, all-caps eyebrow — three-layer typographic hierarchy lifted straight from print magazines.
